description: Estimation and hypothesis testing; analysis of variance and the design of experiments; regression and correlation; analysis of categorical data; distribution-free procedures. Statistical examples and applications from life sciences are emphasized.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete 1 of:
    • STAT252 - Statistics for Business (1.5)
    • STAT254 - Probability and Statistics for Engineers (1.5)
    • STAT255 - Statistics for Life Sciences I (1.5)
    • STAT260 - Introduction to Probability and Statistics I (1.5)
supplementalNotes:
• Credit will be granted for only one of STAT 256, STAT 251, STAT 261.
  • Intended primarily for students in Biochemistry, Microbiology, Biology, and Environmental Studies.
title: Statistics for Life Sciences II
